title: Chinese Lamb Tagine with Roasted Vegetables
description: A fusion twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, this Chinese-inspired dish features tender lamb and roasted vegetables in a rich and savory sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add roasted red peppers, carrots, onions, and garlic. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add Algerian spice blend, soy sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Add water or broth, and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the oven and braise the lamb and vegetables for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
